title: URBADAPT-HEAT v1.0.1: a scalable geospatial framework for city-level public-private adaptation infrastructure cost-benefit analysis and its urban heat risk implementation
description: URBADAPT-HEAT v1.0.1: the code, city configurations, cluster job scripts, pinned environments, figure and table scripts, and the fits behind two model inputs (the LST-T2M emulator and the street-tree cooling coefficients) that produced the results for the four pilot cities (Rome, Athens, Lisbon, Copenhagen) reported in the model description paper by Aboudrar-Méda and Falchetta (Geoscientific Model Development, in review, egusphere-2026-5357). urban-heat/REPRODUCIBILITY.md gives the run commits and settings and documents a rerun that reproduced the archived outputs exactly; urban-heat/DATA_SOURCES.md lists every input dataset with its source, version and licence.
